# Engineering documentation

**Not distributed.** `MANIFEST.in` prunes `devdoc/`, so nothing here reaches a release. The published manual is `doc/`, which is a different audience and a different document set.

| file | holds |
|---|---|
| [specification.md](specification.md) | What ioiocore does, seen from outside. |
| [architecture.md](architecture.md) | How it is built, and why it is shaped that way. |
| [decisions.md](decisions.md) | Append-only. One entry per decision, with the option that was rejected and why. |
| [workpackages/](workpackages/) | One file per package, each with an explicit done-condition. |
| [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) | The engineering record: why each change was made and what was measured. |

## How to read a status

> **The documents are behind the code, never ahead of it.** Trust the code; treat a status as a claim to verify.

The table below is generated from each workpackage's own front-matter, so there is exactly one place a status is written.

## Scope

This repository owns **ioiocore**: the dataflow engine -- nodes, ports, chains, the pipeline, serialisation and logging. It knows nothing about signals, devices or user interfaces. Work about what is *built on* the engine belongs to the consuming repository and is documented there, not restated here.
